g.text: Figure 2i (revises part of 2.2 Figure 2): C1 UI Views, part 2: tab fragments, adapters and helpers (all fragments extend BaseFragment and implement Refreshable)
submitKeepingTop: a list that was at its top
stays there after an update, so a new row
inserted above the visible area is seen.
bindRow: the row button shows only if
= new or changed since Project 2.2 (changed members say what they were);
= removed; plain = unchanged; «new» = class added since Project 2.2;
Every fragment extends BaseFragment and implements Refreshable.
